sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
    'SELECT * FROM dbo.',
    item().TableName,
    ' WHERE UpdatedAt > ''',
    string(activity('lookup lastwatermark').output.firstRow.LastWatermark),
    ''' AND UpdatedAt <= ''',
    string(activity('Lookup Updated at').output.firstRow.CurrentWatermark),
    ''''
)

@concat(
'SELECT * FROM dbo.',
item().TableName,
' WHERE ',
item().WatermarkColumn,
' > CONVERT(datetime2, ''',
string(item().WatermarkValue),
''')'
)
